source_access_caveats: Primary and high-quality secondary sources were read through official pages, publisher excerpts, and indexed document excerpts. Source-level verification fields identify where only excerpts or copies were available; full report calculations and several court PDFs were not independently reproduced locally.
The Justice Department complaint URL returned an HTML page in this sandbox; its filing claims are cross-checked against the official DOJ release and Bloomberg Law.
The Cox opinion copy was hosted by an independent document host; case number and date were checked against CBS reporting.
Anonymous-source assertions on diesel pressure remain attributed to Reuters/NBC and are not stated as confirmed written policy.

unresolved_leads.title: Reuters reports Commerce slowed aircraft-parts export licenses to China
unresolved_leads.exact_gap: The article says licensing had slowed “in recent weeks” but does not date a specific Commerce decision or establish that a discrete slowdown occurred October 1–3. The exact agency action and effective date are needed before this can be treated as a fresh event.

unresolved_leads.exact_gap: Reuters attributes the interception to a New York Times report.
